name: Manual CI trigger matches README Checks
instruction: README Checks tells maintainers how to run the ci workflow manually exactly when that workflow can be run manually.
relevant_when: Diff that adds, removes, or changes workflow_dispatch or the workflow name in .github/workflows/ci.yml, or changes README.md's Checks section about running CI manually.
context: README.md's Checks section currently says: to run the suite manually, open Actions → ci → Run workflow. That instruction is true only while .github/workflows/ci.yml has a workflow_dispatch trigger, and it names the workflow by its name field.
scope_reason: The invariant depends on the workflow trigger and README documentation changing together in one diff.

checklist.name: manual-ci-doc-present-when-enabled
checklist.rule: If .github/workflows/ci.yml has workflow_dispatch after the diff, README.md's Checks section tells maintainers how to run it from GitHub Actions. Return not applicable if the diff does not add, remove, or change workflow_dispatch, the workflow name, or the manual-CI Checks text.

checklist.name: manual-ci-doc-absent-when-disabled
checklist.rule: If .github/workflows/ci.yml has no workflow_dispatch after the diff, README.md's Checks section does not tell maintainers to run the workflow manually. Return not applicable if the diff does not add, remove, or change workflow_dispatch, the workflow name, or the manual-CI Checks text.

checklist.name: docs-match-workflow-name
checklist.rule: Any manual-run instructions in README.md's Checks section name the workflow by the name field in .github/workflows/ci.yml after the diff. Return not applicable if the Checks section has no manual-run instructions after the diff, or if the diff does not change workflow_dispatch, the workflow name, or the manual-CI Checks text.
